verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de has a documented REST API that covers several core UI services: incorporation (create and get), notarization with AI signature-field detection, translation, tax registration (create and poll), trade registration, and HMAC-signed webhooks. Parity with the UI is not shown, though. Webhook registration is done in the dashboard rather than via the API, the Compliance API is Enterprise-only, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API endpoints for apostilles, identity verification, company-name availability checks and webhook management, plus any explicit API/UI parity statement or independent corroboration.
